summary: Rocket Lab Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $3 billion in common stock under an equity distribution agreement with multiple sales agents. The filing also authorizes forward sale agreements with various financial institutions, allowing the company to sell borrowed shares and settle physically later. No specific price, premium, or closing date is provided; the offering is continuous and subject to market conditions. The structure includes forward hedge selling commissions and price adjustments. Watch for dilution risk and stock price pressure from ongoing sales.
